notes.title: Emerald Caravan officially announced!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777272/8d36de8841ee2e7b7202802b6f5632e42c002ab0.png

Hello Guys!

We've got some amazing news to share! We're more than happy to finally announce our next title, Emerald Caravan!

What's Emerald Caravan about?

Emerald Caravan is a shop managment game with RPG and rogue-lite elements. You'll be able to travel across the colorful land, where magic and technology slowly combine into one! Explore dungeons, take care of your shop and sell good you've found and crafted. But there's more to that!

There's more to that!

Your family business collapsed and you'll need to discover what's the reason behind its fall. Also, there are many secrets hidden in the dungeons. What's more, there are crystals that are used as a magic fuel to power up some of the machines. How excatly do they work - that's a mystery that none knows! Is it possible that all of that elements are somehow linked to each other?

We will share more details regarding Emerald Caravan soon! 

It would be awesome if you could follow and support our work! We can't wait to see you the development process of our newest title! Meanwhile, please, see the announcement trailer and lett us know your thoughts in the comments!
